finding: At exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source, the generic outbound Peer contract keeps RequestMetaObject and non-serialized Extensions as separate channels. ServiceRole::Req requires both GetMeta<Metadata=RequestMetaObject> and GetExtensions. Peer::send_request_with_option_and_subscription mutates request.extensions_mut() only to insert OriginatingRequestId when applicable, while request.get_meta_mut() is separately used to inject internal ClientRequestMetadata protocol_version/client_info/client_capabilities. No extension-to-RequestMetaObject bridge is present in this path. Therefore a task request that must carry task-specific wire _meta cannot rely on request Extensions alone; its metadata must already be represented in the typed request's RequestMetaObject (or be explicitly written via get_meta_mut before send by a higher-level helper).
scope_limit: This proves only the generic Peer outbound contract in service.rs. It does not yet prove how get_task/update_task/cancel_task convenience helpers construct their typed requests, because service.rs contains no GetTaskRequest occurrence and the convenience implementation location remains unresolved.
